item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00500","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C22","C01","C20"],"selected_candidate_label":"C22","confidence":0.89,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C22 plausibly supplied the drafting template for the child’s short message to delegates undertaking disarmament work. Both letters open with personal good wishes tied to the recipient’s mission, characterize disarmament as a vital undertaking affecting all mankind, acknowledge obstacles, affirm continued United States determination, and close with wishes for success. C01 and C20 more directly establish the Geneva nuclear-detection conference’s substantive background, but they are diplomatic proposals rather than close drafting models for the child’s encouragement message.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"I send to you, Dr. Bacher, and Dr. Lawrence my best wishes as you depart for a Geneva Conference designed to contribute to disarmament and peace.","parent_excerpt":"I personally follow this matter with the keenest interest and shall follow closely the progress of your task, in which you carry with you my cordial best wishes.","explanation":"Both address an American representative beginning a disarmament mission and frame the message around presidential interest and personal good wishes."},{"child_excerpt":"You are called on to play a significant part in a far-reaching project of deep concern to all mankind.","parent_excerpt":"Of all the problems confronting our country and its government today, none is more vital than that of finding a way to relieve mankind of the burden of devising, developing and maintaining arms which could lead to mankind's self-destruction.","explanation":"The child compresses the parent’s distinctive characterization of disarmament as a vital project concerning mankind as a whole."},{"child_excerpt":"controlled disarmament is so vital that we are going to persevere in the face of whatever difficulties the Soviets may raise.","parent_excerpt":"The United States, together with like-minded nations, is determined to exert every effort to assure that obstacles, procedural or substantive, not continue to interrupt our genuine striving to remove these threats","explanation":"Both pair the vital importance of disarmament with a pledge to persevere despite obstacles."}]}
